question: Amit started from Point A and travelled 9 km east. He then turned right and travelled 6 km. He then turned right and travelled 7 km. He finally turned right and travelled 6 km to stop at Point E. What is the shortest distance between Point E and Point A? (All turns are 90-degree turns only.)
solution:
• Amit started from Point A and travelled 9 km east.
 
• He then turned right and travelled 6 km.
 
• He then turned right and travelled 7 km.
 
• He finally turned right and travelled 6 km to stop at Point E
